Incident Bot: PAGING: P1 — routing policy anomaly detected in us-west-2. Observed p99 12.3s for /v1/generate, p95 1.8s, streaming stalls ~6% of requests. Auto-escalated. root_ts=1715007777
Maya (oncall): on it. seeing the same in alerted dashboards. p99 spike started ~1715007600. customer impact: partial streaming, timeouts.
Maya (oncall): @Darren any recent routing or LB policy rollouts in us-west? :eyes: 
Darren (eng-runtime): I pushed a weight rebalance for routing-policy v2 at 1715007400 to shift traffic off warm pools. Rolling change across zones.
Darren (eng-runtime): I rolled back the config for v2 a few mins ago but might have left partial seeds. checking.
Jen (eng-sre): triage: p95 small, p99 massive — classic hot-partition/handoff. streaming stalls point to misrouted requests hitting slow backends or overloaded pages.
Liam (prodops): I'm going to eject the suspected shard group (shard-az-usw2b-heat-7) from LB rotation and fail to fallback pool. ETA 90s.
Maya (oncall): please annotate customer-facing incidents. @Customer Success do we have active reports? we need count and severity.
Customer Success: two enterprise customers reported degraded streaming (partial responses) and one error spike. CS opened tickets, asking for ETA.
Jen (eng-sre): collecting traces now — enabling verbose router logs for keys that hit slow paths. dropping sampling to 100% for p99 traces in us-west for 10m.
IncOps: syslog snippet showing inflight queuing:
```
[1715007712] router: conn_id=abc123 route=policy-v2 dest=shard-7 queue_ms=4500 backend_ms=6000 kvcache_miss=1
[1715007713] router: conn_id=def456 route=policy-v2 dest=shard-7 queue_ms=5100 backend_ms=6200 kvcache_miss=1
```
Maya (oncall): thanks. that matches warm-kv cache misses + backend slowness. probably policy weights pushed more traffic to a small set of hosts.
Darren (eng-runtime): confirmed — weight table skewed due to an arithmetic bug in the rollout script (division by effective capacity). Reverting full weight table now: `rbac rollback routing-policy/v2 --rev r20260315-42`.
Deploy Bot: rollback started: r20260315-42 -> r20260315-41. initiating graceful drain of affected instances.
Liam (prodops): ejection complete for shard-7 group, rerouting to fallback pool. healthchecks show nodes healthy in fallback.
Maya (oncall): monitoring streaming tail and p99. please hold config pushes in us-west until we validate.
Darren (eng-runtime): rollback applied. verifying KV cache warmup for fallback nodes. warming cache with synthetic prefix load (script: tools/load_warm_cache.sh --region us-west --shard 7).
Jen (eng-sre): running quick canary test against /v1/generate stream (10k tokens) — will report p50/p95/p99.
Jen (eng-sre): canary results: p50 120ms, p95 820ms, p99 980ms. streaming stall rate dropped to 0.4%.
Maya (oncall): p99 down from 12.3s to ~980ms — mitigated. keeping watch for 30m. marking incident state: mitigation in place. paging: notify oncall rotation for followup.
Customer Success: informed customers that mitigation is in progress. CS requests ETA for full root cause and timeline for patch.
Darren (eng-runtime): root cause summary: rollout algorithm miscomputed weight distribution under low capacity signals, created a hot partition. fix: patch rollout script to include bucketed floor, add unit tests, and safety guard to stop >10% reweight to a single shard.
Maya (oncall): assign postmortem to eng-runtime + eng-sre. owners: Darren, Jen. deadline: preliminary RCA in 48h.
Liam (prodops): follow-up actions: add a canary throttle on routing policy rollouts (5% traffic for 10m), add automated detection for abrupt p99 jumps during rollouts.
Jen (eng-sre): adding alerts: new alert rule `RoutingPolicy.Rollout.P99Spike` (threshold p99>3s over 5m) with auto-pause policy.
Incident Bot: STATUS update: mitigation confirmed, p99 stabilized at ~0.9s in us-west-2, streaming stalls <1%. Incident remains open for RCA and cleanup. severity -> P1 -> active mitigation.
Maya (oncall): handing off to night oncall in 30m. @Darren @Jen continue RCA and followups. I'll post final timeline before handoff.
Darren (eng-runtime): noted. will include reproduce steps and patch PR. PR will include unit tests and rollout throttle config.
Jen (eng-sre): capturing timeline and logs to incident channel, will attach traces and sample request ids for debugging.
Maya (oncall): thanks everyone. logging followup tasks: 1) patch rollout guard, 2) add canary throttle, 3) postmortem doc + customer blurb. back to oncall rotation in 30m.
Incident Bot: NEXT STEPS: postmortem assigned to eng-runtime (Darren), eng-sre (Jen). severity P1 -> mitigated state. incident_reference=1715007777
